notes: Filled 2026-11-14. COST = drilling $19.05 (2026 custom rate survey average; median 19.25, range 9-25, 39 responses) + seed 50 lb x $0.25/lb = $12.50 (NRCS Iowa cereal rye fact sheet: 45 lb/acre PLS drilled; cost-share minimum 45 lb; Iowa seed listings $0.235-0.42/lb). COSTSHARE = $20/acre, the 2026 IDALS rate for returning users (first-time $30; up to 160 acres; Greater Des Moines watershed counties $25 on up to 500 acres).
